'''Chapter 872''' is titled "Thick and Fluffy".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The "[[Straw Hat Pirates|Mugiwara 56]]" are wearing clothes resembling [[Raid Suit|raid suits]], in each member's [[Straw Hat Pirates/Miscellaneous#Specific Colors|respective color]].

[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] are wearing a suit resembling [[Vinsmoke Ichiji|Ichiji]]'s raid suit. [[Nami]] and [[Nico Robin]] are wearing a suit resembling [[Vinsmoke Reiju|Reiju]]'s raid suit, with Robin holding [[Vinsmoke Judge|Judge]]'s spear. [[Usopp]] is wearing a suit resembling [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]]'s raid suit and is wearing a helmet similar to Judge's. [[Sanji]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Franky]], and [[Brook]] are wearing double breasted suits, which resembles both Judge's and [[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]]'s raid suit.

Each member has a number that indicate the order they joined the crew: on Luffy's and Chopper's vehicles, Zoro's, Usopp's, and Sanji's belt buckles, on Nami's chest, and on Robin's, Franky's, and Brook's cloaks. Similar to the [[Germa 66]]'s [[Vinsmoke Family|commanders]] and soldiers, who have "66" on their uniforms, the Mugiwara 56 has the number "56" (which can be pronounced as "Go-mu", which mean "Rubber") appear on their headphones, with Luffy, Zoro, and Usopp also having it on their suits, and Nami having it tattooed on her legs. While most of the crew have black cloaks, Nami's is white. Franky's hair also resembles Judge's mustache.

==Short Summary==
The Whole Cake Chateau comes toppling down, and the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hat]]-[[Fire Tank Pirates|Fire Tank]]-[[Germa]] alliance flies away while the [[Big Mom Pirates]] fall. The alliance regroups on the northwestern coast of [[Whole Cake Island]] and goes their separate ways, with [[Caesar Clown|Caesar]] getting his heart back. However, [[Streusen]] cushions the Big Mom Pirates' fall by making the Chateau into soft cake, and the crew plans their pursuit as [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] eats the Chateau. However, this causes her to get a craving for real wedding cake, and her eating disorder starts acting up again.

==Long Summary==
When the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] were staying on [[Fish-Man Island]], the [[Minister of the Right]] had begged King [[Neptune]] to ask them to return the [[Tamatebako]] they had received, as it would likely explode when opened. However, they found out in shock that Luffy had given it to [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] along with the rest of the treasure.

In the present, Whole Cake Chateau starts toppling over after the Tamatebako explodes at its base, and the citizens inside the building start panicking at the structural damage as [[Tamago|Niwatori]] realizes the building is falling down. The citizens of Sweet City are shocked at the sound of the explosion, and run away from the toppling Chateau. Meanwhile, in the wedding venue on top of the Chateau, the [[Straw Hat]]-[[Fire Tank Pirates|Fire Tank]]-[[Germa 66|Germa]] alliance regroups; [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]] says they were saved, but [[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]] replies that that has yet to be seen. The alliance members inside [[Capone Bege|Bege]]'s body are unsure of what is happening, and are awed by the sight in front of them. [[Charlotte Brûlée|Brûlée]] weeps in terror as [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] herself falls off of the venue, and Bege laughs triumphantly as he declares that the [[Big Mom Pirates]] are finished. In Sweet City, the citizens realize they cannot run away from the Chateau in time, and up above a panicked [[Charlotte Galette|Galette]] falls off, only to be rescued by [[Charlotte Katakuri|Katakuri]], who tells her to calm down. [[Morgans]] is too entranced by the newsworthy event happening as he falls, and [[Stussy]] uses [[Six Powers/Geppo|Geppo]] to save herself as she reflects that this could possibly spell doom for the Big Mom Pirates. As the Big Mom Pirates are left to fall, [[Caesar Clown|Caesar]] and the [[Vinsmoke Family|Vinsmokes]] fly the alliance far away.

However, [[Streusen]] drives his sword into the Chateau, cutting off the top part and turning it considerably softer. This allows it to be broken up by the buildings it falls on, protecting the citizens while cushioning the Big Mom Pirates' fall. Big Mom was cushioned by [[Zeus]], and she eats some of the Chateau, remarking that Streusen's creations fill the belly but taste terrible. [[Charlotte Mont-d'Or|Mont-d'Or]] quickly stands back up and reorganizes the crew, ordering everyone to send word to everyone in [[Totto Land]] to prevent the enemy alliance from getting away. In the northwest part of [[Whole Cake Island]], Bege ejects the Straw Hats from his body as they prepare to go their separate ways, and he gives Caesar his heart, allowing him to escape happily. However, [[Vito]] reports that the Big Mom Pirates survived thanks to Streusen, and the Straw Hats prepare to leave; Bege warns them that they will have to make a day's journey to escape from Totto Land. He then plants a sign in the ground pointing in the Straw Hats' escape direction for the Big Mom Pirates to follow them as he coasts away with Castle Tank, much to [[Sanji]]'s ire. Bege's crew regrets not being able to say goodbye to their allies, and the Straw Hats prepare to take the [[Shark Submerge III]] back to the [[Thousand Sunny]].

Meanwhile, Katakuri has [[Charlotte Daifuku|Daifuku]] form up two groups: one to go after the Straw Hats, and one to go after the Fire Tank Pirates. [[Charlotte Smoothie|Smoothie]] assures Big Mom that they will catch the enemy alliance, only to find Big Mom crying out for wedding cake as her eating disorder kicks in again, much to Smoothie's horror. 

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Stussy]] can use [[Six Powers/Geppo|Geppo]].
*[[Morgans]] cannot fly with his wings.
*[[Streusen]] uses his [[Kuku Kuku no Mi|ability]] to save the [[Big Mom Pirates]] from the collapsing [[Whole Cake Island#Whole Cake Chateau|Whole Cake Chateau]].
**According to [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], any food made by Streusen's power is filling but doesn't taste good.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy's]] [[Straw Hat Pirates#Crew Members|group]], [[Capone Bege|Bege’s]] [[Fire Tank Pirates|crew]], and the [[Vinsmoke Family]] escape from Big Mom’s castle.
*The alliance between Caesar, the Fire Tank Pirates, and the Sanji Retrieval Team ends.
**Bege gives [[Caesar Clown|Caesar]] back his [[Ope Ope no Mi|heart]].
*Brook and Chopper separate from the group to recover the [[Shark Submerge III]] while the rest head back to coast where the [[Thousand Sunny]] is docked.
*The [[Big Mom Pirates]] plan to pursue both the Fire Tank Pirates and the Straw Hat Pirates.
*Big Mom begins to show symptoms of a craving illness.
